title: SimpleIndustry
description: Industry without complexity. Create from scratch!
body:
# Industry without complexity

### IMPORTANT !!
> **WHEN CREATING A NEW WORLD, YOU MUST RE-JOIN IT BEFORE STARTING!** This starts the tick function which is vital to SI. It should say, "Welcome, (name)!"

_The latest version, SimpleIndustry 9.0, does NOT include a quest book. This is planned, but for now: you are on your own._

### PREMISE :)

> SimpleIndustry is a 1.20.1 modpack with the goal of letting the player progress quickly while still challenging. Its main focus is _Industry_.
> SimpleIndustry lets you get a feel for factory-like modpacks, without taking a million years and advanced chemistry to complete.

### NO ORES.
In SimpleIndustry, you have to extract things like Iron from Cobblestone, whether through Campfires, Furnaces, or Blast Furnaces. For Iron specifically, its line is:

Cobblestone -> gravel -> raw iron -> iron ingot

### DANGERS...
Be careful! All mobs have been buffed and every fourth mob is an Elite mob. (like infernal mobs from old minecraft) Don't worry- you'll eventually progress enough to stand your ground.

### PROGRESSION!
Once you unlock Tiny Mob Farms, you can easily farm any mob drops. You might not always want to go through so many steps just for iron. There are more examples of progression, but you'll see that later.

### GOALS?
Well... you should set your own goals, but:
- Automate everything!
- Get a ring of flight!
- Compress to the max!
- Overflow your piggy bank!
- Quantum Armor!

> What Durability? and Hunger Remover are included. You may disabled these if you want to.

### MULTIPLAYER?
SimpleIndustry9 has not been tested in multiplayer yet. It should work, but you will have to:
- Create a Fabric 1.20.1 server, copy the mods into (server)/mods/
- Copy the SI Datapack from .minecraft/datapacks/ to (server)/world/datapacks/
- Copy the config from ./minecraft/config to (server)/config/
> It isn't recommended to do this, but it should be possible. I'll make document more about multiplayer later.
